result.title: Decision Model Factory: Building Specialized Sovereign Decision Models
result.summary: Decision needs vary with each application, language, and deployment environment. The Decision Model Factory turns those needs into specialized, sovereign models on demand. A brief recipe guides the training, calibration, verification, and evaluation of a selected backbone, delivering a deployable decision model under the operator's control. The same workflow creates a new specialist whenever the requirements change. Across Japanese decision tasks, compact deployment, and long-context passage ranking, five factory-built models improve upon their backbones; three surpass the strongest results in a fixed public Japanese benchmark comparison. A dedicated runner computes only permitted-answer probabilities and reuses shared context, more than doubling serving speed on matched multi-question workloads with essentially unchanged decision scores. Together, the factory and runner make fast, task-specific decision models practical to build and deploy whenever needed.

AI.brief_summary: 提出「Decision Model Factory」，用固定流程对选定 backbone 做训练、校准、验证与评测，按需生成专用决策模型，并配套只计算允许答案概率、复用共享上下文的推理 runner。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于任务专用决策模型的构建与部署工程，实验为日语决策任务与段落排序，不涉及视觉或多模态输入，也未讨论内部推理状态、证据筛选或停止决策；上下文复用仅是服务加速，缺乏可供核查的 LVR 方法线索。
